name: Unincorporated LA County
holidaysNote: Public Works does not sweep on County holidays, but the Sheriff still enforces posted parking rules: every rule carries flag 1 (not suspended). Dates by the County's holiday rules; Juneteenth and the weekend shifts unverified
fineNote: $50 civil penalty for failure to obey signs (County Code 15.20.070, under which the Sheriff writes street sweeping tickets) plus $10 of court assessments (15.200.020)

words.rule: Posted streets are swept once a week, on the day and in the hours on the sign, one curb at a time: each side of a street has its own sign.
words.afterpass: All year. On County holidays the sweeper skips, but the Sheriff still tickets during posted hours. About $60, no tow.
words.dataNotes: Days and hours are Public Works' street sweeping map, which draws each curb as its own line; CURB laid each posted curb on the County's street centerline on the side it runs along. Streets without sweeping signs (16,685 of the map's lines) are left out: nobody is ticketed there.
